text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The fateful moment is finally upon us! The 
Birthday of El Condor Pasa!!" || "The 
fateful moment is finally upon us! The 
birthday of El Condor Pasa!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Entrance of the well-wishersssss! AAAIRRRR 
GROOOOVE!!!! SIIIILEEEENCE SUZUKAAA!!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Woooould you look at that!! Air Groove 
unleashes an avalanche-style gift 
delivery!? Could this be an early end to 
the match!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah, I have one too, though...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Without missing a beat, Silence Suzuka 
presents her gift too! They're locked in a 
fierce collar-and-elbow tie-up!! Who will 
make the first move!?!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Aaaand what's this!? While both 
competitors rack up humility points—the 
birthday champion, El Condor Pasa, is 
poised to make a run for it!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you don't chase after them, you won't 
be able to deliver the present!! A 
completely unexpected sudden race!! What a 
thrilling turn of events, YES!!!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Why can't she just accept a present 
like a normal person...?
